entries.note: Independent audit (not the translator) of cli.vault at source hash 88cd0862f4e2: 24/24 keys present in en order; ICU placeholder names/kinds parity with en ({endpoint}, {org}, {minutes}, {until}, {url}); every backticked command (`lop vault connect`, `lop login radient`, `lop team-bridge setup`) byte-identical; Ctrl+C, Radient Vault, Radient Team, Local Operator, JSON and 600 kept verbatim; {url} stays last in revoke_hint; NFC, no bidi/zero-width controls; repo check.py --catalogues-only 0 problems. Safety meaning checked against en .context.json: compare tells the person to check the 16 groups on the approval page BEFORE approving and never claims the harness verified anything; unavailable/not_team carry no up-sell or retry advice; connected_until bounds READ access at {until}; disconnected/revoke_hint keep local-key removal distinct from console revocation. Glossary: agent, approvals, credentials, team plan and 'agent messages' (matches cli.team_bridge / cli.team_bridge_hold) checked against this locale's catalogues and style guide; 'vault' and 'fingerprint' have no prior catalogue rendering, so this namespace sets them. Register vous; U+202F before ':' and ';' verified by codepoint (8 keys); U+2019 apostrophes. Findings 0 blocker / 2 major / 2 minor, all majors fixed: (M) waiting lacked the required fr CLDR `many` arm — added `many {# de minutes}` (renders '1 000 000 de minutes'); (M) no_access rendered the product 'Vault membership' as 'adhésion au coffre' while not_approved says 'adhésion à Vault' — now 'votre adhésion à Vault'; (m, fixed) connected_until 'les coffres que vous lui avez partagés jusqu’au {until}' let the date attach to 'shared' and used the 'partager à qqn' calque — now 'Jusqu’au {until}, cet agent peut lire les coffres que vous avez partagés avec lui.' Minor deferred: endpoint is rendered 'point de terminaison' in key_heading while wire.settings keeps the Latin 'endpoint'; not a glossary row and the bep_ id beside it disambiguates, so left for a glossary decision. Unresolved blocker/major: 0. Plurals one/many/other rendered at 1/2/5/21/1000000 with the repo formatter. Single independent audit pass by a different agent on the SAME model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5); no cross-model second audit; no native-speaker or rendered-frame certification. Corrections were applied by the auditor at the manager's instruction (team radientdev); the corrected strings have no second independent audit, and a separate re-audit of them is recommended.
